claims.claim: PRIMARY hosted admission uses the explicit profile policy from the checkout at the invocation SHA, independent of cwd and installed-package location.
REMEDIATION hosted admission uses the same explicit invocation-bound profile policy path and profile resolution.
Coding REPAIR hosted admission uses the same explicit invocation-bound profile policy path and profile resolution.
Executor-less REPAIR does not load an execution-profile policy, including when an explicit nonexistent path is supplied.
Omitted and explicit model and effort dimensions retain one profile binding and their respective REPOSITORY_DEFAULT and EXPLICIT source attribution.
The hosted carriers forward the resolved executor, model, effort, and source tuple without downstream re-resolution or substitution.
Issue data cannot select the workflow’s trusted profile policy path; carrier policies no longer discover a sibling profile authority.
Invalid or unavailable explicit profile policy rejects coding admission before dispatch, and bounded receipts retain unobserved execution outcomes.
The Issue #532 regressions make implicit lookup unavailable, change cwd, and exercise admission through the explicit canonical policy source.
The repair leaves the core resolver, self-host workflows, durable dispatch identity, Runtime verification, Reviewer, Publisher, and lifecycle semantics unchanged.
